bund07.scope: Actual screenshot review of near/oblique integration and distant scene continuity, read alongside the separate exact asset/owner tests.
bund07.observations: Thick window frames, columns, cornices, sign and crest are visible; foreground paving supports the avatar. Near and distant representations show no obvious duplicate target facade.
limitations: This is bounded visual integration review, not surveyed dimensions, photometry, laser scanning, or whole-city photo reconstruction.
Other nearby ordinary buildings retain inferred geometry, height and materials; the surrounding street environment is not fully restored.
No hardware frame-rate or memory-performance claim follows from software-rendered browser screenshots.
